# Vocablo

> Vocablo is a native iPhone, iPad, and Mac app that teaches Mexican Spanish
> vocabulary through Home Screen, Lock Screen, and desktop widgets, backed by
> practice games, streaks, and on-device Apple Intelligence conversation
> practice. No account required; everything runs on device.

## Key facts

- Platforms: iOS 17+, iPadOS 17+, macOS 14+ (fully native, SwiftUI).
- Widgets: iPhone Home Screen and Lock Screen, iPad Home Screen, Mac desktop.
  Multiple widgets can run side by side, each rotating a different topic.
- Dictionary: 550+ curated, frequency-graded words and phrases tuned to
  conversational Mexican Spanish, organized into 13 topics.
- Practice: Matching, Type the Word, El o La (grammatical gender), and an
  Apple Intelligence conversation mode with per-turn coaching — all on-device.
- Pronunciation: system speech synthesizer with a Mexican Spanish voice.
- Privacy: no accounts, no ads, no tracking, no backend. Optional sync across
  devices uses the user's personal iCloud.
- Pricing: free tier (beginner words, four starter topics). Vocablo Plus
  unlocks all 13 topics, every difficulty, and iCloud sync — $2.99/month or
  $14.99/year with a one-week free trial.
- Developer: Luke Hollenback (solo, independent).
